data.name: 3R-BioPhosphate
data.description: 3R-BioPhosphate Ltd. is a Hungarian family-owned pyrolysis engineering company led by inventor Edward Someus that upcycles food-grade animal bones and wood biomass into ABC BioPhosphate fertilizer (a calcium-phosphate biochar) and Terra-Preta wood biochar at its 30-ha 3R-BIOFARM Upcycling Centre in Trans-Danubia. The company's primary business is EU-authorized, REACH-certified phosphorus recovery and biofertilizer production, with carbon-negative biochar as a co-product of its zero-emission pyrolysis technology (2,000–20,800 t/y throughput).
